g.title: metamodel
g.text: L3 --- ARRUS ultrasound domain model (device-agnostic core)

g.title: Device
g.text: Base for every device in ARRUS.

g.title: Probe
g.text: A probe instance connected to an ultrasound device.

g.title: File
g.text: File-based ultrasound "device" that replays recorded data.

g.title: ProbeModel
g.text: Static, immutable description of a probe model (P4-1, C5-2, L14-5, ...).

g.title: ProbeModelId
g.text: Identifier of a probe model: (manufacturer, name).

g.title: Lens
g.text: Optional acoustic lens on the probe surface (elevational focus).

g.title: MatchingLayer
g.text: Optional acoustic matching layer on the probe front face.

g.title: CPU
g.text: The host CPU as a compute device.

g.title: GPU
g.text: A CUDA GPU as a compute device.

g.title: GpuSettings
g.text: Runtime settings for a GPU device (memory pool, memory-limit fraction).

g.title: legend
g.text: after edge name — ordered or has named constraints
